instruction: Reverse the order of all applications in your favorites dock.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires reversing the order of favorite apps from [thunderbird, vim, chrome] to [chrome, vim, thunderbird]. Uses custom metric to verify exact order.

llm_judge_reasons: Semantic verification is correct: getter extracts the right state (favorite apps order via gsettings command), metric compares exact list equality, and expected values are correctly the reversed order
Complete coverage: instruction requires reversing order and evaluator verifies exact order match with all three apps in correct positions
Expected value handling is correct for type='rule': metric correctly accesses 'expected.get("expected_order", [])' directly since expected IS the rules dictionary returned by get_rule
Proper security: metric uses ast.literal_eval() for safe string-to-list parsing instead of eval() (lines 16-20)
Robust error handling: try-except block catches malformed input and returns 0.0, plus validation that parsed result is actually a list (lines 16-24)
Logic is sound: exact list comparison (apps == expected_order) correctly verifies that all apps are in the exact reversed order
